description: List topics in the connected user's Skwirl library with note counts, highest count first; ties have no guaranteed order. Read-only and takes no parameters. Returns text lines in topic: count form, or 'No saves yet.' Use to understand the library's subject mix before search_stash; use list_stash_mentions for named books, places or other entities, or recent_stash for newest notes. Usage examples: list_stash_topics({}). Returns text.
name: list_stash_topics
